name.value: The Salt Spring Centre of Yoga

description.value: The Salt Spring Centre of Yoga is BC's longest-running spiritual and wellness retreat centre, established in 1981 on 69 acres of protected Agricultural Land Reserve on Salt Spring Island. Founded by master yogi Baba Hari Dass, the non-profit centre offers yoga teacher training, multi-day silent and themed retreats, a working organic farm, and personal retreat stays in a serene rural setting. A cycling tourist exploring Salt Spring Island could find this a distinctive cultural and wellness destination, though it operates primarily as a reservation-based facility rather than a drop-in attraction.
